//: Device build for sideloading via SideStore. withoutCredentials skips
EAS's signing setup entirely, which is what makes this possible with
no paid Apple Developer account — SideStore re-signs with your free
Apple ID at install time instead.
distribution:internal produces a downloadable artifact rather than
something aimed at App Store Connect.
EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is baked in AT BUILD TIME, not read at
runtime — so the backend has to be deployed before this build runs,
and pointing the app somewhere else later means rebuilding.
Runs in the iOS Simulator on a Mac — no device, no signing, no
SideStore. Useful for checking the UI compiles and navigates, but it
CANNOT test the camera: the Simulator has no camera hardware, so
